questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina in an emergency: 'I have a patient with a crown that has come off! I'll re-cement it right away!' Mina replies: 'Not so fast! We need to analyze the cause first.' Why should the cause be analyzed before re-cementing?
options: To identify an occlusion, preparation, or material problem that could recur
Because the patient wants a new crown
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A decementation can reveal an underlying problem. Re-cementing without analyzing risks recurrence.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, I'll do an occlusal analysis first...'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a removable prosthesis that no longer stays in place. Sami says: 'It needs to be remade!' Mina replies: 'What if it's just the clasps?' What can cause loss of retention?
options: Wear of the clasps, bone resorption, or deformation of the prosthesis
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Loss of retention is often multifactorial. Simple replacement of the clasps may suffice.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right, let's start by checking the clasps!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, during a consultation, says: 'For your 3-unit bridge, we need crowns on both abutments.' Mina intervenes: 'What if we did a bonded bridge?' What is a bonded bridge?
options: A bridge fixed by wings on the adjacent teeth, without preparation of the abutments
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The bonded bridge is a conservative option when the abutment teeth do not require preparation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I prefer conventional bridges, but I admit this one is less invasive.'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient who wants a zirconia crown, but he has severe bruxism!' Sami replies: 'Zirconia is strong, it'll be fine!' Mina says: 'Not so sure!' Which material is most indicated in case of bruxism?
options: Metal-ceramic or monolithic zirconia for their resistance
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'In case of bruxism, resistant materials like metal-ceramic or monolithic zirconia should be prioritized.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are well informed about materials!'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina examine a patient with an unstable complete denture. Sami says: 'We need implants!' Mina replies: 'What if it's just an occlusion problem?' What is the most frequent cause of instability?
options: An occlusion or adaptation defect of the prosthesis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Instability is often linked to occlusion or adaptation. An occlusion adjustment may suffice.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, we'll revise the occlusion before considering implants.'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, discussing with a patient, says: 'Your ceramic crown is the most aesthetic.' Mina intervenes: 'But it is more fragile depending on occlusal forces.' Where should a ceramic crown be placed?
options: On anterior teeth or premolars with controlled occlusion
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Pure ceramic is indicated for anterior aesthetics, but it is more fragile in high-load areas.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are really an expert in materials!'

questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a removable prosthesis that is irritating the gum!' Mina replies: 'Check the adaptation and occlusal balance.' What are the causes of irritation under a prosthesis?
options: Pressure points, adaptation defect, or faulty occlusal balance
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Irritations are often due to localized pressures or poor occlusal balance.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right, let's correct the balance!'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a bridge that moves. Sami says: 'It needs to be remade!' Mina replies: 'What if it's just the cement?' What is the most frequent cause of a moving bridge?
options: Cement failure, fracture, or loss of retention
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A moving bridge can be due to cement failure or fracture.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll check the cement first!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, during a consultation, says: 'For your root-treated tooth, we need a post and core.' Mina asks: 'What if we just did a composite?' What is a post and core?
options: A core build-up for anchoring a crown on a root-treated tooth
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The post and core reinforces the root-treated tooth to receive a crown.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right, it's the most durable solution.'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient who wants veneers, but he has very dark teeth!' Sami replies: 'Ceramic veneers hide everything!' Mina says: 'Not always!' What is the limitation of veneers?
options: Veneers do not mask very dark stains or severe discolorations
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Veneers have limits for deep stains. A bleaching or crown may be more indicated.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll propose bleaching first.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina examine a completely edentulous patient. Sami says: 'Conventional denture, it's cheaper!' Mina replies: 'And implants could improve his quality of life.' What are the advantages of implants?
options: Improved stability, comfort, and preservation of alveolar bone
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Implants offer unmatched stability and comfort, in addition to preserving bone.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are really convincing!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, talking to a patient, says: 'Zirconia is the best material for your crown.' Mina intervenes: 'It is aesthetic but it can be abrasive for opposing teeth.' What is zirconia?
options: A high-strength ceramic material, very aesthetic, but potentially abrasive
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Zirconia is aesthetic and resistant, but its abrasiveness is a factor to consider.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, I'll polish the zirconia to reduce abrasion.'

questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient who wants a prosthesis on 4 implants, but he has little bone!' Mina replies: 'We can do shorter or tilted implants.' What is a tilted implant?
options: An implant placed at an angle to optimally use available bone
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Tilted implants allow using available bone in areas of low height.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are really an implant specialist!'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a maxillary removable prosthesis. Sami says: 'The palatal plate is too extended!' Mina replies: 'It is necessary for retention.' What is the role of the palatal plate?
options: Ensure retention and stability of the maxillary prosthesis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The palatal plate is essential for the retention of the maxillary prosthesis.' 🦅 Sami: 'OK, I'll optimize it but not remove it.'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, during a consultation, says: 'Your metal-ceramic bridge will last 15 years.' Mina intervenes: 'If hygiene is good!' What is the key factor in the longevity of a bridge?
options: Only the quality of the laboratory
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The longevity of a bridge depends on hygiene and regular follow-up.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are really foresighted!'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient with a broken temporary crown!' Sami replies: 'Let's put the definitive one on right away!' Mina says: 'Not so fast!' Why is the temporary crown important?
options: To protect the tooth, maintain space, and evaluate aesthetics and function
Because the definitive crown is not ready
To get the patient used to it
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The temporary crown is an essential phase to validate the prosthetic project.' 🦅 Sami: 'OK, we'll remake a quality temporary.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina examine a patient with a fractured tooth. Sami says: 'We extract and place an implant.' Mina replies: 'What if we could save it with a crown?' When can a fractured tooth be saved?
options: If the fracture does not extend below the gum and enough tooth structure remains
Only if the tooth is root-treated
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Deep subgingival fractures have a poor prognosis.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right, in this case the implant is the best option.'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, talking to a patient, says: 'Your removable prosthesis is perfect.' Mina intervenes: 'It still needs to be checked every year.' Why is annual follow-up recommended?
options: To check adaptation, clasp condition, and tissue health
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Annual follow-up allows early detection of adaptation or wear problems.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan regular check-ups.'

questions.question: 📞 Sami calls Mina: 'I have a patient with a broken prosthesis!' Mina replies: 'Is it repairable?' When can a removable prosthesis be repaired?
options: If the fracture is simple and the prosthesis is recent
Only if the prosthesis is resin
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'Simple fractures on recent prostheses are repairable.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you're right, we'll repair it.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a mandibular complete denture that floats. Sami says: 'We need an implant!' Mina replies: 'What if we adjusted the prosthesis?' What is the most frequent cause?
options: Bone resorption and lack of retention
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Bone resorption is the main cause of loss of retention of mandibular prostheses.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, we'll discuss the options with the patient.'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, during a consultation, says: 'CAD/CAM will replace the laboratory!' Mina replies: 'The laboratory remains essential for complex cases.' What is CAD/CAM in prosthetics?
options: Computer-aided design and manufacturing for making prostheses
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'CAD/CAM allows making prostheses faster.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, CAD/CAM is a tool, not a replacement for the laboratory.'

questions.question: 📞 Mina calls Sami: 'I have a patient who wants a 6-unit bridge!' Sami replies: 'That's too long, we need implants!' Mina says: 'It depends on the abutments.' What is the limit of a bridge?
options: The length is limited by the quality of the abutments and the occlusion
A bridge can replace up to 10 teeth
A bridge can only replace one tooth
A bridge can replace all teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The length of the bridge depends on the quality of the abutments.' 🦅 Sami: 'Fine, we'll evaluate the abutments before deciding.'

questions.question: 🏥 Sami and Mina receive a patient with a crown that has a different color. Sami says: 'It needs to be remade!' Mina replies: 'What if we adjusted the color with the laboratory?' How to choose the color of a crown?
options: With a shade guide under natural or neutral lighting
questions.explanation: 🦅 Sami explains: 'The color choice is made with a shade guide and adapted lighting.' 🐆 Mina: 'Sami, you are an expert in aesthetics!'

questions.question: 🗣️ Sami, discussing with a patient, says: 'Implant-supported prostheses are the best solution.' Mina intervenes: 'But it costs more and requires surgery.' What are the disadvantages of implants?
options: Higher cost, longer treatment time, and surgical risk
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Implants have disadvantages that must be explained to the patient.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will present all options to the patient.'

questions.question: 🦅 Sami and 🐆 Mina discuss the future of prosthetics. Sami says: 'Artificial intelligence will replace us!' Mina replies: 'Not so fast, clinical diagnosis remains human.' What is the future of prosthetics?
options: AI helps with diagnosis and design, but the clinician remains the master
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'AI is a powerful tool, but clinical judgment remains essential.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'm reassured, we keep our jobs!'
